On the road to Survivor Series: WarGames in Houston, the WWE makes a pit stop in Riyadh for an epic night of massive title bouts during Crown Jewel.

Watch on DirectV

The premium live event features four high-profile Raw vs. SmackDown matches, including Roman Reigns taking on Sami Zayn for the WWE Crown Jewel Championship, Liv Morgan goes face-to-face against Chelsea Green for the WWE Women’s Crown Jewel Championship and other bouts.

When and Where Is WWE Crown Jewel 2026?

Crown Jewel happens on Saturday (Nov. 7), beginning at 12 p.m. ET/9 p.m. PT. The event takes place at ANB Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances During WWE Crown Jewel 2026?

The WWE is known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance, even in Saudi Arabia. Celebrities who have been known to appear at events in the past, include Logan Paul, Cardi B, Mike Tyson and others.

What’s the Match Card for WWE Crown Jewel 2026?

In 2026, there are four matches for the WWE premium live event. The main event is men’s and women’s Crown Jewel Championship matches.

Match Card:

- WWE Crown Jewel Championship: Roman Reigns (Raw’s World Heavyweight Champion) vs. Sami Zayn (SmackDown’s Undisputed WWE Champion)

- WWE Women’s Crown Jewel Championship: Liv Morgan (Raw’s Women’s World Champion) vs. Chelsea Green (SmackDown’s WWE Women’s Champion)

- Last Man Standing Match: Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton

- World Tag Team Championship: The Vision (champions) vs. Penta and Je’Von Evans
